7906816233010.sourceDescription:
Product Features
Set of 2 Aspen Fir: Bring natural forest charm to your home with this set of 2 artificial Christmas trees. Each tree features an Aspen Fir silhouette with 147 tips and a decorative gold-tone pot base, creating an elegant, full evergreen look for indoor seasonal decoration.
Dual-colour remote lighting: Each tree features 110 pre-lit LEDs with warm white and multicolour options. The included 5m remote control offers 11 lighting functions, including steady glow, breathing flash, mixture fades and wave modes, allowing you to easily customise your festive ambience.
Lifelike PE craftsmanship: The outer branches feature individually moulded PE tips that replicate the soft texture and natural appearance of real evergreen needles, while dense PVC inner tips add depth and fullness for a realistic look.
Battery powered for flexible placement: Powered by a battery box, these Christmas trees can be placed anywhere without needing a wall outlet. Their compact design makes this 2-piece set ideal for symmetrical placement beside front entryways, doorways, fireplace mantels, hallway corners or in small spaces.
Convenient build and storage: Each 4 ft tree separates into manageable sections for easy, space-saving storage. The PE tips naturally retain their shape and require minimal shaping. Just 10–15 minutes of light shaping is enough to achieve a full appearance. Contact us for helpful shaping tips.
 
Please Note
All dimensions are measured manually, so slight variations of 2–3 cm may occur.
Actual colours may vary slightly depending on monitor settings and screen displays.
Decorative items shown in the pictures are not included in the delivery.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Compact Format

Thirty plastic baubles in red, green and gold measure 6 cm in diameter. The included hooks provide hanging points for a Christmas tree or a seasonal arrangement built around these three colours. The coordinated contents let you plan the main colours and shapes before placing the individual decorations, so the arrangement can follow the space available.

The plastic construction provides the shape for the decorative finish. Each piece can be moved between branches as you arrange the tree, so you can judge the balance of the display before settling on a position. Keep the front and outline visible by allowing some space between neighbouring decorations, particularly where several branches meet.

Hanging hooks are included, providing a way to attach the decorations to the branches. Position the ornaments at different heights to follow the outline of the tree, checking each attachment as you work. The same hanging format also allows individual pieces to be used in a wreath or garland when there is a suitable place to secure the hook.

The rounded shape gives these decorations a familiar bauble outline. Repeating that shape across several branches creates a rhythm through the tree without needing every ornament in the wider display to match. A small group can also be used within a wreath or garland, placing the balls where their curved surfaces are visible between the greenery.

Designed as hanging decorations, the pieces can be distributed across the branches or brought together in a smaller seasonal arrangement. Start with the areas that face into the room, then turn the individual ornaments until their shapes can be seen.

When taking down the display, remove each decoration from its support before packing it away. Keep the pieces together and avoid placing heavy objects against their decorative faces. This keeps the collection organised for the next time you arrange a Christmas tree or seasonal display.

8941467526110.variantName: 190 Christmas Window Stickers Reusable Static PVC Snowflake Santa Cling Decals for Indoor Christmas Decoration
8941467526110.sourceDescription:
This pack contains 9 sheets holding 190 Christmas window stickers in total. The sheets mix snowflakes, Santa, reindeer, a snowman, gift boxes and Merry Christmas lettering, so you can arrange a full festive scene across a window or spread the designs over several rooms. The motifs vary in size, which lets you build a balanced layout with larger pieces at the centre and smaller snowflakes around them.

The stickers are made from durable PVC with a static cling backing rather than glue. They are water resistant and odour free, lift off cleanly and leave no sticky residue behind, so the same set can be used again next December. Apply them to windows, glass, doors, mirrors and any other smooth surface, and avoid car windows, where heat can make the film shrink or peel.

Because the design is printed on both sides, the motifs read clearly from inside and outside the glass, which matters for shop fronts, conservatories and street facing windows.

Set up takes a few minutes: wipe the area with a damp cloth, peel a sticker from the sheet, press it into place, smooth out the water and air bubbles, then blot any excess moisture with a clean cloth. No glue, tools or fixings are needed, and the stickers peel away without harming the glass.

They suit indoor Christmas decorating, children's parties, classroom and office windows, and family craft afternoons in the run up to the holidays. Small parts are included, so supervise young children during use.

Christmas Tree Decorations
These Christmas tree decorations add a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Paper. Stated size: 1 x 0.1 x 27 cm. Product weight: 0.12 kg. Quantity: 50 pack.
Festive Father Christmas motif adds a recognisable seasonal character to your display.
Includes a generous 50-pack quantity for extensive decoration coverage.
Crafted from paper material for lightweight and easy hanging on branches.
Versatile design allows pairing with other ornaments to create a coordinated theme.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Included: 50 pack of paper ornaments

8956086363510.sourceDescription:
Pink acrylic snowflakes are the Frozen-kingdom version of the tree decoration, and this set brings eighteen pieces across five styles: eight snowflakes of varied design, five crystal-drop icicles and five pearl-garland strands. Each arrives with ribbon on top, so hanging them is a branch-by-branch pleasure rather than a project.

The clear pink acrylic reads like crystal, catching the tree lights and scattering them softly, and the mixed styles let a whole scheme build from one box. The acrylic is robust and shatter-resistant rather than fragile, and light enough for the thinnest branches.

They suit trees, wreaths, windows, chandeliers and the winter-wonderland party that the children have been planning since October.

Material: Acrylic
Eighteen pink pieces across five styles
Snowflakes, icicle drops and pearl garlands
Reads like crystal, catches and scatters light
Ribbons pre-fitted for branch-by-branch hanging
Shatter-resistant acrylic for family households
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use

Decorative Hanging Ornament
Adds a decorative detail to the chosen display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Red Berry Accents
Red berry accents introduce small points of colour among the surrounding foliage. They add contrast to the festive arrangement and make it straightforward to repeat a red colour theme across neighbouring Christmas accessories.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details

Compact 50 cm diameter size is ideal for standard doors, windows, or mantelpiece displays.
Durable plastic construction ensures long-lasting vibrancy and resilience for seasonal use.
Versatile decorative wreath suitable for enhancing Christmas displays throughout your home.
Comes with 1 piece Christmas wreath

Striped Pattern

Choose your fit

Care after wearing

Party Decorations
These party decorations add a decorative detail to the chosen display. The white finish and glass construction give them a defined appearance for living room.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Material: Glass. Colour: White. Quantity: 1 piece.
Lightweight glass construction allows for easy handling and convenient storage when not in use.
Designed to create a striking focal point within living room displays or party arrangements.
Features a refined white finish that adds a defined, elegant appearance to any setting.
Single item pack offers flexible styling options to coordinate with existing decor themes.
Guarantee - 1 month

Product Introduction

 This Solar Christmas Projection Wall Light is a perfect outdoor holiday decor lamp. 
 Powered by solar energy, it projects vivid colourful Santa Claus patterns and festive snowflake elements onto walls, patio or fences. 
 It features dusk-to-dawn auto sensor design, automatically charges under sunlight in daytime and lights up at night, no wiring or extra electricity cost needed. 
 The hollow-out cylinder casing creates stunning large projection effect, adding warm and magical Christmas atmosphere to your outdoor space.

Material & Specifications

 Power Supply: Solar powered, built-in rechargeable battery
 Pattern: Colorful Santa Claus, snowflakes & Christmas elements projection
 Size: 8.5cm × 8.5cm / 3.34in ×3.34in
 Charging Time: 5-8 hours under full sunlight
 Working Time: 6-12 hours after fully charged
 Material: Durable plastic housing, solar panel
 Feature: Auto on at dusk, auto off at daytime, wire-free installation
 Application: Outdoor use, waterproof for garden, porch, patio, fence, exterior wall

Application Scenarios
Great Christmas outdoor decoration for patio, garden, porch, backyard, fence and exterior house walls. Ideal for Christmas party, holiday event decoration, seasonal display. It is also a wonderful festive gift for family and friends, bringing amazing
 projected holiday visual effect to your home.
Notes

 Place the solar panel in direct sunlight for better charging performance.
 Suitable for outdoor use, but avoid long-term soaking in standing water.
 Working duration depends on sunlight intensity and charging hours.
 Simple wall mount design, easy to install without cables.
FESTIVE CHRISTMAS PROJECTION: The Solar Christmas Projector Outdoor Wall Light features intricate cutout designs of Christmas trees, bells, snowflakes, gifts, and seasonal figures, casting decorative shadows across nearby walls, fences, and outdoor gathering areas.
LIGHTING MODES: Colored lights display a rich array of colors, adding a festive atmosphere to Christmas parties, family gatherings, and winter nights.
SOLAR POWERED ILLUMINATION: The integrated solar panel charges in approximately 5–8 hours of direct sunlight and provides about 6–12 hours of lighting, depending on sunlight exposure, weather conditions, and the selected lighting mode—no outdoor wiring required.
AUTOMATIC DUSK-TO-DAWN OPERATION: Position the solar panel in an area with unobstructed sunlight and switch the unit on. After charging, the built-in light sensor automatically activates the illumination at dusk and turns it off during daylight.
IP65 WATERPROOF & FLEXIBLE PLACEMENT: Constructed with a decorative iron housing and an IP65 waterproof design for seasonal outdoor use. Mount it on a wall, fence, or deck post for projected patterns, or place it on a tabletop, porch ledge, or patio as a freestanding holiday accent.

5037204472710.variantName: Inflatable Santa - Christmas Display Decoration - Father Christmas Motif - Fabric White and Gold - Christmas at Home - 1 Piece
5037204472710.sourceDescription:
Inflatable Santa
This inflatable santa adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The white and gold finish and fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
